title: Vividly Spicy Norwegian Egg Frittata
description: A spicy and festive Norwegian dish featuring egg yolks and cheese, perfect for a keto-friendly breakfast, this frittata combines the richness of eggs with the bold flavors of Norwegian cuisine. The blanched vegetables add a nice crunch and freshness to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt until well combined.
In a large skillet, cook the sliced spicy norwegian sausage over medium heat until browned.
Add the blanched red onion and chopped fresh dill to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a greased 9-inch pie plate, arrange the cooked sausage and onion mixture in the bottom of the plate.
Pour the whisked eggs over the sausage mixture and top with shredded norwegian cheese.
Bake the frittata in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh dill and diced smoked salmon if desired.
